summary: Added an interrupted-run notice in Conversation.svelte (detects persisted tools stuck at 'running' while idle) plus CSS, then verified the full app with svelte-check, prettier, and vitest. During verification, a stale `ConversationPlaceholder` import in MessageList.svelte had to be removed, and a vitest failure was traced to the new notice and a project-dot sharing `role="status"` with toasts; both were switched to non-conflicting roles. Final state: 0 type errors, 37 files / 174 tests passing, detector 14→4 findings, with `pnpm check:loc` failures shown to be pre-existing.
decisions: Interrupted-run notice is rendered as a plain div with `data-ui="interrupted-notice"` (not `role="status"`) to avoid colliding with toast live regions used in tests and UI.
Project-dot indicator in Titlebar.svelte uses `role="img"` with `aria-label` (instead of `role="status"`) so it doesn't compete with toast live regions.
Failed tool-call collapsed cards surface the error text inline (2 clamped lines, clickable to expand) instead of relying on a red X alone.
Dead `ConversationPlaceholder.svelte` component and its unreachable `conversation-empty` CSS are deleted; `thread-empty` is now workspace-aware ('Ask about {workspace} to start.').
Pre-existing `pnpm check:loc` violations (7 files over 300 lines, including SessionSidebar.svelte) are left as-is, verified against the committed tree to not be a regression of these changes.
errors: svelte-check failed with 'Cannot find module ./ConversationPlaceholder.svelte' because the import in MessageList.svelte was not actually removed by an earlier edit batch despite a success message; fixed by reapplying the import removal.

Vitest integration test 'confirms thread deletion with a cancel path and reports the result' failed because the new `data-ui="interrupted-notice"` carried `role="status"` and was matched by findByRole('status') before the toast; fixed by dropping that role on the notice.
Follow-on vitest failure traced to Titlebar's project-dot also using `role="status"`; fixed by changing it to `role="img"` with an aria-label.
